title: Maintenance report triage
summary: Route equipment notes to a maintenance specialty.
why: A work-order system needs a trade or review queue.

trade.instructions: Which specialty matches the described symptom?

criteria.mechanical: Moving parts, vibration or physical wear
criteria.facilities: Leaks, building fixtures or room issues

state.note: The conveyor bearing grinds and vibrates during rotation.
Rainwater is leaking through the warehouse ceiling.

limitation: Routes reports only. Does not diagnose equipment or authorize repairs.
